_comment: Planned parts of the Corvus mirror of the local assistant model. NOT in the manifest: data/local_ai.json keeps the mirror source's parts empty (the Store skips it and uses its built-in source) until the mirror is public. Publish-time step: once the parts answer 200 without sign-in, copy each part's url, bytes and sha256 into data/local_ai.json's corvus source, in order. The mirror host must be public; a private repository cannot serve the Store.
